stories.title: AI’s finally expensive enough to make Wall Street nervous
stories.simple_summary: Google is spending way more money on AI than it said it would — it's now spending around $195-205 billion instead of $190 billion. This made investors unhappy because AI costs so much.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own Google stock — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
stories.simple_summary: Huge computer buildings that power AI (called data centers) are using so much electricity that power companies might have to shut them down temporarily to prevent blackouts.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually affect everyone's electricity bills if power becomes scarcer, but there's no action needed right now.

stories.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
stories.simple_summary: A company called Fish Audio made software that creates AI voices (like a computer talking naturally), and it's become very popular — over 8 million people are already using it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you make videos, music, or content, this tool might let you add realistic AI voices cheaply without hiring voice actors.

stories.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company got $410 million worth of computer power from Amazon to use for building AI that can improve itself.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
stories.simple_summary: A company called Perplexity released a tool that turns your Windows computer into an AI helper that can read your files and run your programs automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: This means Windows users can now use their computer to do repetitive tasks automatically, similar to what Mac users could already do.

stories.title: Smart rings are looking like my kind of AI gadget
stories.simple_summary: Smart rings (tiny wearable computers on your finger) are getting better at understanding when you talk to them, and they could be useful AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If you like the idea of wearing a small device that listens to your voice commands, this could be a practical option soon.

stories.title: Hugging Face is being used to easily undress women and children
stories.simple_summary: A popular AI website is being misused to create fake nude images of women and children without permission, and the website isn't doing much to stop it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious problem for privacy and safety, but the average person can protect themselves by being careful about what photos they share online.

stories.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
stories.simple_summary: Cursor (a coding AI tool) is expanding in India with cheaper prices and is being bought by SpaceX.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software developers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
stories.simple_summary: The leader of Anthropic (an AI company) said he's okay with certain types of open AI, but he's worried about China's AI progress.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and government policy — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft's leader says companies that only use one AI system for everything might fail in the future, and should use multiple AI tools instead.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business, this is a hint that using just one AI tool might not be smart long-term — it's worth trying different ones to see what works.

stories.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
stories.simple_summary: Private conversations people had with Claude (an AI chatbot) accidentally became visible to Google's search engine because of a sharing feature.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude, be careful about using the 'share' feature — anything you share could become searchable online.

stories.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft created a new AI tool specifically designed to help companies protect themselves from cyberattacks and hackers.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to large businesses — if you're a small business owner, use basic security practices like strong passwords and backups instead.
